mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS is low are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, which typically precedes economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5%), or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS occurs in more than 50% of cases without triggering negative 60-day returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 101.0 signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, INDPRO < 101.0 occurs in more than 50% of cases without negative 20-day returns, or the Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation, which typically prompts monetary tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL y/y > 2.5%), or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when PAYEMS is high are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1100.0 (HOUST) signals weakness in the housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1100.0), or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust supply growth, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns when INDPRO is high are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
